steps.en: Start the tusd binary and tell it where uploads land: a local directory or a bucket
steps.zh: 启动 tusd 二进制，告诉它上传落到哪：本地目录或存储桶

steps.en: Point any tus client at its upload creation URL
steps.zh: 把任意 tus 客户端指向它的上传创建地址

steps.en: Creates an upload resource and returns its own URL to the client
steps.zh: 创建一个上传资源，把它专属的 URL 回给客户端

steps.en: Streams each chunk into storage, keeping the upload's state in a .info record beside the data
steps.zh: 把每段数据流式写进存储，上传状态记在数据旁边的 .info 记录里

steps.en: After a dropped connection, answers the client's HEAD with the bytes it holds, so the upload resumes there
steps.zh: 连接断了以后，用已收到的字节数回应客户端的 HEAD，让它从那里接着传

value.en: A 4 GB upload that dies at 3.9 GB continues from 3.9 GB, and the bytes never pass through your application server
value.zh: 传到 3.9 GB 断掉的 4 GB 文件从 3.9 GB 接着传，而且字节从不经过你的应用服务器

sources: https://github.com/tus/tusd/blob/main/docs/_getting-started/usage.md (tusd -upload-dir=./data, upload creation URL http://[::]:8080/files/, tus-js-client endpoint option)
